notes.title: LYSFANGA: THE TIME SHIFT WARRIOR - FREE UPDATE
notes.content:
We are happy to share that Lysfanga: The Time Shift Warrior got a new update that brings a much-awaited feature and many quality-of-life improvements. 

[h2]ONLINE LEADERBOARD
[/h2]
In this update, you will have access to two leaderboards for the Story Arenas as well as Figments of Battle challenges.  

Compare your scores with your friends and the best players from around the world! 

[h2]WARRIOR CHALLENGES[/h2]

We are bringing a new time challenge to the Story Arenas! 

Once you beat the standard time challenge in an arena, you will unlock “Warrior Challenges”, a.k.a. the times set by the developers themselves! 

Do your best and try to beat us! 

[h2]RAZER CHROMA INTEGRATION
[/h2]
We are also adding Razer Chroma RGB™ integration to the game! 

If you have a compatible device, you will have access to new RGB effects that will enhance your experience while playing the game! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2161620/Lysfanga_The_Time_Shift_Warrior/

notes.title: Lysfanga : The Time Shift Warrior Patch note 1.02.001
notes.content:
[h3]New[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Quality of Life: You can now switch weapons while in Overview mode.
    [*]HUD: The currently equipped rune is now displayed in the bottom-left.
    [*]HUD: Added a slight background to improve remnant count readability.
    [*]UI: Default cursor has been updated to be more visible.
    [*]UI: Tutorials videos have been updated.
[/list]

[h3]Balancing[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Orb of Light damage slightly increased.
    [*]Flood of Light damage increased.
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Gameplay: Fixed an issue that caused the game to get stuck in the 4th boss' phase 4.
    [*]Gameplay: Fixed an issue causing Bombwings to sometimes be stuck in mid-air.
    [*]Gameplay: Fixed an issue that caused some Figments of Battle levels with the “Lightning Fast” challenge to not start properly in Simplified Chinese.
    [*]Gameplay: Fixed an issue that caused the echoes triggered by Paroxysm to incorrectly be blocked by Guardians, causing an additional issue in a related Figments of Battle challenge.
    [*]Gameplay: Binary Doors and Magical Doors no longer destroy thrown projectiles on contact.
    [*]Gameplay: Fixed an issue that caused some colliders to destroy thrown projectiles on contact.
    [*]Gameplay: Rune of Weapon Mastery now deals more consistent damage to enemies.
    [*]Gameplay: Rune of Crystalline Massacre now deals more consistent damage to enemies.
    [*]Gameplay: Some Magical Doors now open more quickly.
    [*]Gameplay: Fixed several collision issues.
    [*]Text: Fixed typos in various languages.
    [*]Graphics: Fixed issues related to some spells VFX.
    [*]Graphics: Fixed Glaring Light VFX not replaying correctly upon second use.
[/list]

notes.title: It is almost time to fight. Lysfanga: The Time Shift Warrior releases tomorrow!
notes.content:
[h1]RELEASE TIMING[/h1]

The game releases February 13th 4PM CET. 
Check the map below to know the exact release timing for your region:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224797/a9345dceb984bff42d9f2d41086bdf3fe53a8b9f.jpg[/img]

[h1]PRICING[/h1]
Lysfanga: The Timeshift Warrior is available at 24.99$/€ with a 20% launch discount for the whole first week of the release. 

[h1]CONTENT[/h1]

After half a millennium of peace, a new danger hangs over Antala. Its fate depends on you, Imë, Lysfanga of the New Kingdom, protector of the realm. Gifted with temporal powers from the Goddess of Time herself, something no other Lysfanga has had before, you have the ability to rewind time in combat to summon clones of your past-selves to help you. Master your power to become legion, and crush hordes of the escaped demons, known as the Raxes.

[h2]STORY MODE[/h2]
The old time-locks are gone. The Raxes are now free to create chaos again. Explore the abandoned cities of the old continent previously locked in time and uncover the truth behind the resurgence of the Raxes. Fight your way against hordes of monsters and explore the diverse environment of Antala in search of the truth. On your path you will find new weapons, spells and runes that will help you face the different enemies of the realm. 

[h2]FIGMENTS OF BATTLE[/h2]
Looking for new challenges to push your limits? Test your skills in the Figments of battle: in this alternative game mode unlocked through the story mode, you have the opportunity to replay arenas you have previously cleared with new gameplay modifiers that will demand adaptation and creative gameplay. The game mode also has a dedicated scoring system that will you push you to find new tactics to achieve the highest scores. Will you be able to beat all the challenges awaiting you? 

[h1]ACHIEVEMENTS[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224797/1a52bd2e2aaf3b2f4941d94e4f1423b1171d107c.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224797/59e72393fca7c59351ae28dd7b6e7715f362f1dd.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224797/60fafe30b2c95b4e4a178bd00fba4e37a0057ae5.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224797/52454e5e549586be81d4704e4c670d9921be0fd9.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224797/e75ff0503eab30255022812993dff42585a6c5cf.png[/img]
63 achievements will be available to unlock during your journey in Antala! Complete Imê's journey, find the secrets of the New Kingdom, and beat all the challenges to unlock them!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2161620/Lysfanga_The_Time_Shift_Warrior/

notes.title: New Hades like Steam game is the perfect answer to Diablo 4 Season 3
notes.content:
Oh Diablo 4 Season 3, how I wanted to be excited about you. While it was always going to be hard to follow Season 2's vampiric mechanics, the Season of the Construct has struggled to move the needle at all, with its trap-focused additions and spidery companion failing to enthral me. As a result, I've found myself at a little bit of a loss, craving something hacky and slashy to fill the void. Thankfully, new Steam roguelike Lysfanga The Time Shift Warrior has stepped in.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: The Steam Next Fest Demo is out now!
notes.content:
Greetings Warriors, 

We are excited to have our first public demo here at the Steam Next Fest! It is available now to download and play and will be up until the 12th of February. 

The demo will have many arenas that offer you a wide range of gameplay opportunities. You will be able to choose different weapons and spells to better suit your playstyle. Try everything the demo has to offer and get the best possible time score! 

[h1]Learn more about Lysfanga: The Time Shift Warrior in this new Gameplay Overview Trailer. [/h1]

Discover all the tools at your disposal during the Steam Next Fest Demo in this extended Gameplay Overview video! 

[previewyoutube=ZtWHXHQKLFQ;full][/previewyoutube]

In Lysfanga: The Time Shift Warrior, you play as Imë, a powerful warrior gifted with temporal powers from the Goddess of Time herself. You have now the ability to rewind time in combat and fight alongside clones of your past selves. In your quest of saving Antala, you will unlock a multitude of new weapons, spells, remnants and ultimates that will help you crush hordes of the escaped demons, known as the Raxes and save the Kingdom. 

[h1]Steam Next Fest Livestream [/h1]
 
Join Game Director Thibault Legouet and other developers from Sand Door Studio as they play the Steam Next Fest Demo! Come and watch as they share stories & cool behind the scenes info about the creation of the game! 

This livestream will go live on February 6th at 6:30 P.M. (CET).
